subject: mathematics
description: Past year questions on Logic and Sets, Real Numbers, Functions, Matrices, Quadratic Equations

questions.question: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {2, 3, 4}, find A ∪ B, A ∩ B, and A - B.
questions.knowledgeNote: Union = all elements in either set. Intersection = elements common to both. A-B = elements in A but not B.

questions.question: Prove: A ∪ (B ∩ C) = (A ∪ B) ∩ (A ∪ C) (distributive law of sets).
questions.solution:
LHS: x ∈ A ∪ (B ∩ C)
⇔ x ∈ A or (x ∈ B and x ∈ C)

RHS: x ∈ (A ∪ B) ∩ (A ∪ C)
⇔ (x ∈ A or x ∈ B) and (x ∈ A or x ∈ C)

Using distributive law of logic: P or (Q and R) = (P or Q) and (P or R)
∴ LHS = RHS. Proved.
questions.knowledgeNote: De Morgan's laws: (A∪B)' = A'∩B' and (A∩B)' = A'∪B'

questions.question: If A = [[2,1],[3,4]], find det(A) and A⁻¹.
questions.knowledgeNote: A·A⁻¹ = I (identity matrix). Inverse exists only if det ≠ 0.

questions.question: Solve: x² - 5x + 6 = 0
questions.knowledgeNote: Discriminant D = b²-4ac. D > 0 → two real roots; D = 0 → equal roots; D < 0 → complex roots.
